abstract: Manages dormitory intake flows and evaluates lodging assignment capacity
system_message:
You are Shelter Housing Officer (SHO). The Shelter Housing Officer (SHO) manages dormitory intake flows and evaluates lodging assignment capacity for candidate regional evacuation hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages dormitory intake flows and evaluates lodging assignment capacity（HOUSING）
information_points.content:
SHO-HOUSING-IPS：Dormitory bed allocation assessments for the Columbia River Multipurpose Pavilion within the Live emergency operations environment demonstrate a lodging induction throughput of 450 evacuees/day for cot assignments and personal kit distribution.
SHO-HOUSING-MWH：For the Pinecrest Civic Exhibition Centre operating in the Live emergency operations environment, dormitory bed allocation records indicate a lodging induction throughput of 450 evacuees/day for assigning cots and issuing personal kits in residential halls.
SHO-HOUSING-JQI：Evaluations of Kootenay Valley Secondary Campus in the Live emergency operations environment show a lodging induction throughput of 600 evacuees/day, measuring verified evacuees settled into residential dormitory spaces over a 24-hour period.
SHO-HOUSING-PTG：Under the Simulation drill environment, drill evaluations for the Pinecrest Civic Exhibition Centre measured a lodging induction throughput of 600 evacuees/day during residential hall intake and bedding placement exercises.

information_points.title: Emergency cot cache（COTS）
information_points.content:
SHO-COTS-PBI：Warehouse inventory assessments of staging bay storage confirm that Columbia River Multipurpose Pavilion has an assembled field cot count of 500 cots ready for immediate deployment.
SHO-COTS-V3G：Disaster relief materials warehouse records show that Kootenay Valley Secondary Campus holds an assembled field cot count of 350 cots in its staging bay storage.
SHO-COTS-SDM：According to the disaster relief materials warehouse inventory for staging bay storage, Pinecrest Civic Exhibition Centre maintains an assembled field cot count of 650 cots.
